title: The Canon of the Unreadable Sky
summary: A canon on becoming a sky that no watcher can read so that every plan laid against the user fails.

title: Treatise of Seven Broken Patterns
summary: A treatise naming seven kinds of pattern in a fighter's art and the means of breaking each in turn.

title: The Windward Havoc Mastery
summary: A mastery of wild assault in the Azure Sky style that rides the wind and breaks every line it meets.

title: The Sapphire Entropy Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of the slow undoing of all order and the cold patience with which it is brought to a foe.

title: Canon of the Churning Heavens
summary: A canon on stirring the heavens above a battle into a churn that drops broken force on both friend and foe alike.

title: The Gale-Sworn Chaos Canon
summary: A canon by which a gale-sworn student turns the sworn wind itself into a storm of unplanned force.

title: Treatise of the Unsworn Wind
summary: A treatise on the wind that answers to no oath and bends to no hand and so cannot be turned.

title: The Long Coast Tumult Mastery
summary: A mastery of tumult as met on the Long Coast where wave and wind and sail are all thrown into confusion.

title: Manual of the Scattered Host
summary: A manual on scattering the order of a great force until each member fights alone and in confusion.

title: The Oath-Voices' Discord Canon
summary: A canon sung in the dissonant voice of the Oath-Voices that jars every sworn word and every fixed form.
